disclaimer.title: Product Disclaimer
disclaimer.body:
Statements about our dietary supplements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. These products are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

Product information on this site is for general education. For advice about whether a supplement is right for you, talk with your healthcare provider, especially if you take medication, are pregnant or nursing, or have a health condition.

contact.title: Contact & Store Hours
contact.body: We’d love to hear from you. For product or service questions, call the shop or visit us in Ortonville, Minnesota. Use the link below for our current phone number, location, and store hours.

shipping.title: Shipping & Returns
shipping.body:
Shipping is $8 for merchandise totals of $100 or less and free for merchandise totals above $100.

Returns

Thank you for supporting our small business. Because of the nature of our botanical and personal care products, all sales are final, and we’re unable to accept returns or exchanges.

We want you to feel confident before you order. If you have questions about a product please contact us. We’re happy to help you choose.

about.title: About Wildwood & Willow
about.body: Wildwood & Willow Botanicals offers handcrafted botanical products and wellness services in Ortonville, Minnesota.
